if we write somewhere that there should be an 'r2' "tag" in the
filename of the GWS6 CDF, then it's wrong. The 'r2' tag is only for
the GWS5 CDF. Please let us know where you read that; hopefully you
just mixed up the two chip types. At least I don't see this in the
Vignette 'Total Copy Number Analysis (5.0 & 6.0)':

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/total-copy-number-analysis-6-0

In other words, the CDF you should be using is either of the two
GenomeWideSNP_6.cdf and GenomeWideSNP_6.Full.cdf. Make sure to follow
the suggestions on how to rename the latter. You find more details on
GWS6 at:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/genomewidesnp-6

Hope this helps

Henrik
